decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 3 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 47 Worton Way.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northeastern or southeastern flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, the south west corner of the proposed first floor side extension shall be constructed with a grey brick quoin	detail to match that on the existing front and side elevations.  This shall be permanently retained.
description: Erection of first floor side extension and rear dormer roof extension to dwellinghouse.
